status_summary: No proposed or final OCR rule since 2025-01-20 on crisis standards of care, quality-adjusted life years or denial of treatment to disabled newborns was found. HHS published a proposed rule on 2025-12-19 that would amend only the Section 504 exclusions provision on gender dysphoria, leaving the 2024 Section 504 rule's other provisions in place. H.R. 3864, introduced 2025-06-10 and still in committee, would bar federal health programs from using quality-adjusted life years in coverage and payment decisions by statute; it is not the OCR rulemaking the recommendation describes.

timeline.event: H.R. 3864, the Protecting Health Care for All Patients Act of 2025, was introduced in the House and referred to the Ways and Means and Energy and Commerce Committees; it would amend Social Security Act section 1182(e) to bar federal health programs from using quality-adjusted life years in coverage and payment decisions. No later action is recorded; it is related legislation, not an OCR rule.
